source_stage: Approved ART-06C v02 living tortoise, fitted MOB-06 rig-v01

geometry.simplification: Automatic triangle collapse after coincident-position welding; two duplicate faces removed by validation. No manual retopology or normal bake.

fit.source_coordinates: Blender Z-up, -Y forward; GLB Y-up, +Z forward. A 180 degree yaw aligns the head with native -Z.
fit.capsule_limit: The broad shell silhouette differs from the unchanged upright radius .35 / height 1.3 collider. Aspect ratio, targeting and contact reach are preserved.

material.orm_colour_space: linear data: G roughness, B metallic; source AO retained
material.scar_colour_space: linear data: R core, G damage, B connected travel delay
material.clock: Pause-aware ambient clock, per-instance phase. Native status takes priority; scars never deal damage or heal.

integration.legacy_mesh_scale_purpose: Presentation cancels only the native .76 humanoid reduction. The 1.25 family size and optional elite size live on the parent mesh and apply once.
integration.cosmetic_stride_purpose: At native 2.6m/s and family 1.25 this gives about 1.39 heavy gait cycles/sec. Foot sliding accepted without changing native speed.
integration.timing: Normalized native windup; native attack_released(strike) starts existing CreatureMotion cosmetic release window. No damage events or movement tracks.
integration.continue: Existing transient_actor_presentations reset clears cosmetic release; no persistent fields.

known_limits: Foot sliding from deliberate native cadence; no runtime terrain IK. Short head/neck release is cosmetic; the native contact envelope remains larger than the visible head.
Generated fine cavities and weight transitions remain prototype quality.
One runtime detail level; full performance impact and owner playtesting deferred.
Physical era variants and significant underground lag remain separate work.
